title: Create Savage Elite gaming team signup and merch shop

requirements.text: Create a team signup form that collects gamer tag, email, preferred game role, and experience level for joining Savage Elite gaming team

quotes: Make a sign up app where you sing up for my gaming team called savage elite

acceptanceCriteria: Form includes fields for gamer tag, email, preferred game role, and experience level
Form submission stores member data in the backend
User receives confirmation after successful signup
Form validates required fields before submission

requirements.text: Build a merch shop displaying Savage Elite branded products with product images, names, descriptions, and prices
acceptanceCriteria: Shop displays multiple merch items in a grid layout
Each product shows image, name, description, and price
Products are stored and retrieved from backend
Users can view product details

requirements.text: Implement shopping cart functionality allowing users to add merch items, view cart contents, and adjust quantities
acceptanceCriteria: Users can add products to cart from shop page
Cart displays all added items with quantities and subtotals
Users can increase, decrease, or remove items from cart
Cart shows total price calculation

requirements.text: Create an admin interface to manage team member signups and view submitted applications
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can view list of all signup submissions
Each submission displays gamer tag, email, role, and experience level
Admin can approve or reject applications
Interface is accessible only to authenticated admin users

requirements.text: Design a bold, gaming-focused visual theme with aggressive colors (blacks, reds, neon accents) and edgy typography that reflects the 'Savage Elite' brand identity consistently across all pages
acceptanceCriteria: Color palette uses dark backgrounds with vibrant accent colors appropriate for gaming
Typography choices convey strength and competitive gaming culture
Visual style is consistent across signup form, merch shop, and all UI components
Design includes gaming-appropriate visual elements (geometric patterns, sharp edges, etc.)

requirements.text: Display generated Savage Elite logo and merch product images as static assets from frontend/public/assets/generated
acceptanceCriteria: Logo is displayed prominently in the header/navigation
Merch product images are rendered in the shop interface
All images are served from frontend/public/assets/generated directory
Images load correctly without backend routing

constraints: Use single-actor Motoko architecture for all backend logic
Do not modify immutable frontend paths (useInternetIdentity, useActor, main.tsx, components/ui)
Use React with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and React Query for frontend
Store all team signup and merch data in the main Motoko actor
nonGoals: Payment processing integration (Stripe or external payment gateways)

required: Savage Elite gaming team logo with aggressive, competitive styling featuring sharp edges and bold typography (savage-elite-logo.dim_512x512.png)
Gaming t-shirt mockup with Savage Elite branding on black fabric (merch-tshirt.dim_800x800.png)
Gaming hoodie mockup with Savage Elite logo on dark fabric (merch-hoodie.dim_800x800.png)
Gaming mouse pad with Savage Elite design and vibrant colors (merch-mousepad.dim_800x800.png)
Gaming cap/hat mockup with Savage Elite embroidered logo (merch-cap.dim_800x800.png)
